s1.name: the new-chat home screen

personas.expectation: I think this is the starting screen where you type a new question, probably a new chat. Guessing.
personas.cue: Nothing names it. I worked it out from the empty middle, the three suggestions 'Start a voice chat', 'Create an image or sticker', 'Write or edit', and the input field that says 'Ask ChatGPT'.

personas.solution: Put a plain title in the top bar, for example 'New chat'.

personas.expectation: I believe this is the starting page, where one begins a conversation with the machine. But that is a deduction, not something I was told.
personas.cue: The box at the bottom that says 'Ask ChatGPT', and the three lines 'Start a voice chat', 'Create an image or sticker', 'Write or edit'. There is no heading at all; the only words at the top are 'Get Plus', which is an advertisement, not a place.
personas.why: Nothing on this screen names it. If the telephone rang and I came back, I would see a blank page and have to reason out from the writing box what I was doing. 'Get Plus' at the top tells me nothing about where I am.
personas.solution: A plain heading at the top, such as 'New conversation' or 'Home', in the place where 'Get Plus' now sits.

personas.expectation: I think this is the opening screen of the app, where you begin a new conversation. I am guessing, because nothing actually says so.

personas.expectation: Something has interrupted me to say the microphone is switched off, and it wants to send me to the telephone's settings.

personas.expectation: I am being told to turn on the microphone in the phone's settings before I can use Voice. Underneath, I think I am still on a chat screen, but I am guessing about that part.

personas.solution: Give the message a short heading like 'Microphone needed for Voice', and name the screen behind it, so that when I press Cancel I know what I am returning to.

personas.expectation: I'm in the voice part of the app and it's stopped me with a box asking me to switch on the microphone.

It also warns I'll be sent off to Android settings and have to come back, and that's exactly where I lose track.
personas.solution: A bold title on the pop-up like 'Microphone needed for Voice', and a name on the voice screen behind it so when I come back from settings I know I'm in the right place.

s2.recommendation: give the dialog a title that says where it belongs, e.g. "Voice — microphone access", and keep the home screen behind it less heavily dimmed
